description:
Job Title: AI Software Engineer 
 
Job Category: Information Technology 
 
Time Type: Part time 
 
Minimum Clearance Required to Start: Top Secret 
 
Employee Type: Regular 
 
Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 10% 
 
Type of Travel: Local 
 
* * * 
 
 
 Join CACI as an AI Engineer driving the rapid modernization of an existing software system through AI-powered development. You'll leverage cutting-edge AI coding tools, spec-driven development practices, and modern software engineering techniques to accelerate application design, development, testing, and deployment. You may also integrate Generative AI and agentic capabilities into the modernized product to deliver intelligent, scalable, and high-impact solutions. If you are passionate about using AI to transform how software is built and what software can do, you want to be part of this team.

 Responsibilities: 
 AI-Powered Application Development: Leverage AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and other AI coding agents to rapidly design, build, refactor, test, and deploy production-ready applications. Apply spec-driven development approaches to translate business requirements into structured specifications, implementation plans, and AI-generated code.
 Rapid Product Modernization: Modernize an existing commercial software product by accelerating the transformation of legacy components, improving application architecture, enhancing user experiences, and introducing modern technologies. Use AI-powered development practices to reduce delivery timelines while maintaining code quality, security, and maintainability.
 Agentic Software Engineering: Apply agentic coding workflows to automate and accelerate software development activities, including requirements analysis, code generation, refactoring, test creation, debugging, documentation, and code reviews. Establish repeatable development patterns that combine AI-driven execution with human oversight and validation.
 GenAI Implementation: Design, develop, and integrate AI capabilities into the modernized product, including RAG pipelines, conversational AI, intelligent automation, and agentic workflows. Implement solutions using LLM APIs, vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and managed AI services.
 Integration & Operationalization: Integrate LLM APIs, AI services, and modern application components into existing product workflows. Implement responsible AI guardrails, observability, security controls, cost tracking, monitoring, and alerting while troubleshooting complex integration issues.
 Modern Development Practices: Apply spec-driven development, automated testing, CI/CD, and agile engineering practices to accelerate delivery. Use AI to generate and validate code, develop unit and integration tests, maintain technical documentation, and improve development efficiency without compromising engineering standards.
 Reusable Engineering Patterns: Develop reusable specifications, AI coding instructions, application templates, components, and implementation patterns to streamline development. Continuously refine AI-assisted engineering workflows based on practical experience and emerging capabilities.
 Quality & Operational Validation: Ensure AI-generated and human-developed code meets established functional, performance, security, and reliability requirements. Conduct code reviews, validate generated outputs, and establish repeatable quality assurance practices to support production readiness.
 Continuous Learning: Stay current with advancements in AI-powered software development, coding agents, agentic engineering frameworks, and GenAI technologies. Experiment with emerging tools and methodologies, assess their applicability to product modernization, and share learnings through demonstrations, documentation, and technical discussions.
 
 Qualifications: 
 Required: 
 Bachelor’s Degree.  Will consider experience in lieu of education
 5-7 years of professional software development experience
 2 or more years of demonstrated JavaScript/Angular proficiency; demonstrated ability to build, modernize, and maintain production applications using modern development practices
 Experience using version control (Git), and collaborative engineering workflows.
 1 or more years of professional experience utilizing Claude code and LLM models
 Willing and able to obtain a DoD Security clearance
  
 Desired: 
 Experience with advanced Claude Code capabilities 
 Experience building and operating agentic AI systems using frameworks such as Agno, LangGraph, CrewAI, or OpenAI Agents SDK, with hands-on use of LLM observability platforms (LangFuse, LangSmith, Weights & Biases), vector database technologies (Chroma, Weaviate, pgvector, Pinecone), guardrails implementation, and structured output patterns. 
 AWS experience, particularly with AWS Bedrock and GovCloud environments; Azure experience with Azure OpenAI Service 
 JavaScript/TypeScript/Python proficiency across frontend and backend development 
 Experience leveraging AI to generate automated tests, perform code analysis, identify vulnerabilities, and validate application functionality. 
 
 
 
- 
 

 What You Can Expect: 
  A culture of integrity. 
 At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.
 An environment of trust. 
 CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.
 A focus on continuous growth. 
 Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.
 
 

 Pay Range : 
 There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.
 
 Since this position can be worked in more than one location, the range shown is the national average for the position.
 
 The proposed salary range for this position is: 
$82,100-$172,400 
 
 CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.
